improvements.message: Consider adding more granular scoring criteria or weights for specific gaming events (e.g., boss fights, speedruns) to better align with user expectations.
Enhance filtering capabilities to support multi-select filters for categories and games, as this would improve usability for users managing large datasets.
Upgrade localStorage to IndexedDB for better scalability and performance when handling larger datasets.
Include wireframes or mockups for the GUI to provide a clearer visual representation of the design.
Add a troubleshooting section to guide users on resolving common issues, such as import errors or missing data.
Expand the smoke test to include edge cases, such as importing malformed JSON or handling empty datasets.

payload.quality_target: Enhance usability and scalability for larger datasets while maintaining simplicity and modularity.
